title: International Parliamentary Scholarships
summary: Up to 120 sponsorships for young graduates from 50 nations are awarded every year by the German Federal Parliament, inviting them to Berlin for 5 months including a 3-month work placement with a member of the Bundestag.

subject_areas.notes: Higher-education degree (at least a Bachelor's) in any subject.

institutions.notes: Awarded by the Bundestag together with three of Berlin's higher-education institutions: the Freie Universität, the Humboldt Universität and the Technische Universität.

nationality.notes: Nationality of one of the participating countries. Palestinian Territories is also listed in the text.

residence.notes: Sponsored students are invited to Berlin for a period of 5 months.

mandatory.text: nationality of one of the participating countries
higher-education degree (at least a Bachelor's) in any subject
very good German language skills (corresponding to level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)
under 30 years of age at the time of commencement of the sponsorship

preferences.text: highly qualified, open-minded and committed young graduates with a strong interest in politics from the participating countries who are willing to play an active and responsible role in shaping the democratic futures of their countries

funding.description: 700 EUR per month, free accommodation, health-, accident- and liability insurances, and allowance for the graduate's inbound and return journey.
funding.duration: 5 months, each year from 1 March to 31 July (Exception: German-French Parliamentary Scholarships start on 1 October and end on 31 July every year)

application_rounds.notes: Application deadlines vary depending on the country of origin.

steps.text: Please see all application forms and further information on the application procedure on the programme's website.

sources.title: German Bundestag: International Parliamentary Scholarships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme invites international young graduates to Berlin for a 5-month period including a work placement, fulfilling student/graduate exchange/study funding for time physically researching or studying in Germany.
